comments.author: Kryptic-S01
comments.body_html:
After trying this ReShade preset and looking at the new screenshots you shared, I can tell the minor difference with from before to after. If you know where to look at you can see the differences, but there are other options from other mods that use ReShade that I think do a better job, but other users may disagree.

I’m not saying this is a bad mod at all, in fact it’s good to have variety with ReShade presets, but I just think this one isn’t as appealing to use as other ReShade preset mods, in my opinion. Some people like subtleness, others like a moderate>major graphical overhaul. I’m slowly but surely heading towards more subtleness, less overbearing colours and darker contrast mainly because I’m getting old.

comments.author: goflockyourself

comments.author: goflockyourself
comments.body_html:
you’re absolutely right in the opinion that this barely changes anything, and that’s the point.
this isn’t a huge graphical overhaul or even a slight one, obviously i never intended it as such

i plan to make one more preset that incorporates this into it, whilst also trying to make the game just look prettier without it affecting gameplay, an eyesore to look at (as the point of this preset already is) and just not too over the top. after that, bloating the hub with reshade presets can be someone else’s job, as i plan to start work on server-sided mods in the future

i simply didnt like how much the game was almost blurred in a way with TAA on, so i tinkered with stuff till it looked sharper, nicer and in my opinion better

thanks for your constructive criticism, i will try my best to improve with it.
